'''Teleport crystal''' is a single-use item received when starting the [[Gauntlet]]. It teleports players back to the starting room.

Additional crystals can be created with 50 [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]].

==Trivia==
* Attempting to use the teleport crystal in the starting room gives the message {{mes|You don't need to use that in this room.}}.
* Attempting to use the teleport crystal in the boss room gives the message {{mes|That won't help you now. At this point in the Gauntlet, you win or you die.}}.
